waystones.configuration.title: Vardesteiner
Set to 'NONE' for no inventory button. Set to 'NEAREST' for an inventory button that teleports to the nearest waystone. Set to 'ANY' for an inventory button that opens the waystone selection menu. Set to a waystone name for an inventory button that teleports to a specifically named waystone.
waystones.configuration.worldGen.nameGen: Set to 'PRESET_FIRST' to first use names from the custom names list. Set to 'PRESET_ONLY' to use only those custom names. Set to 'MIXED' to have some waystones use custom names, and others random names.
waystones.configuration.worldGen.spawnIn: Set to true if waystones should be added to the generation of villages. Some villages may still spawn without a waystone.
waystones.configuration.client.disableTe: If enabled, the text overlay on waystones will no longer always render at full brightness.
